title: decisions-lint configuration
description: The decisions.yaml of a project: the decision API to use, the files to lint, the rule files to import, and the rule values this project changes.

provider.description: The decision API that answers the rule questions.

name.description: jev for TypeSafe AI System One, openai for the OpenAI Decisions API, ollama for a local Ollama server, localai for LocalAI, openai-compatible for any chat completions server with JSON schema output.

model.description: The model identifier, such as jev-latest, gpt-6-luna or llama3.1.

api_key_env.description: The environment variable that holds the API key, never the key itself; local servers run without one.

base_url.description: The scheme and host of the API, for a proxy or a compatible endpoint.

timeout.description: Seconds to wait for one response.

concurrency.description: How many requests are in flight at once.

paths.description: Directories, files or globs relative to decisions.yaml to lint.

exclude.description: Globs relative to decisions.yaml to leave out.

fail_on.description: The weakest severity that makes the check exit 1; error when omitted.

imports.description: Rule files to load, relative to decisions.yaml; later files override earlier ones.

rules.description: Rules this project defines or changes, keyed by rule id; an entry for an imported rule overrides only the keys it sets.
